def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    trade_prices = [41.50, 41.75]
    prevailing_bids = [41.45, 41.73]
    prevailing_offers = [41.50, 41.75]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    effective_spreads = []

    for trade_price, bid, offer in zip(
        trade_prices, prevailing_bids, prevailing_offers
    ):
        midpoint = (bid + offer) / 2
        effective_spread = 2 * abs(trade_price - midpoint)
        effective_spreads.append(effective_spread)

    average_effective_spread = sum(effective_spreads) / len(effective_spreads)

    # return answer
    return round(average_effective_spread, 3)
